name: voiceover-video
description: Turn a voice recording into a fully animated, captioned, sound-designed short video. Includes the model-agnostic voiceover-video engine and the Kimi-branded kimi-video edition.
author: Dancan254

interface.shortDescription: Turn a voice recording into an animated vertical Short
interface.longDescription: Voice note in, animated vertical Short out: word-level captions, kinetic typography, camera moves, synthesized sound design and a voice-ducked music bed. The workflow runs entirely on your machine using local transcription, headless Chromium rendering, and FFmpeg encoding. Also includes a Kimi-branded edition tuned for Moonshot AI and Kimi K3 content.
